notes.title: [Patch] Dokapon Kingdom: Connect Fixes/Updates
notes.notes:
Hello [i]Dokapon Kingdom: Connect[/i] players,

Today [b](9/28 @ 10am PDT)[/b], there will be several updates to the Steam release of [i]Dokapon Kingdom: Connect[/i]. You can find the previous and updated functions listed below:

[h2][b][Adjustments/Fixes][/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Upon startup, the game defaults to full screen. [/list]
[h2][b][Title Screen/Menu Button UI][/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] In menus (before game startup) button icons will now switch automatically depending on type of controller being used.
[*] Button icons will be shown when using a controller and keyboard keys will show if using a keyboard.
[*] *Note: Button icons/keys will not switch automatically during a game and will still need to be swapped in the settings menu. [/list]
[h2][b][Settings Screen: Game Window Size][/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Previous[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Returns the size of the game window to its default setting.[/list]
[h3][b]Updated[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Returns the size of the game window in window mode to its default setting. [/list]
[h2][b][Added Functions][/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Settings[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Full Screen options allows players to toggle between fullscreen and window mode.
[*] Help Description allows players to change the game into full screen. Can also be toggled with "Alt + Enter". [/list]
[h2][b][Offline Mode Name Input][/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Allows keyboard input for player name. [/list]
[h2][b][Keyboard Name Input Message][/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] The input message "Please enter your name in 10 characters or less." will now be shown as prompt before inputting a player name.[/list]
Best,
Team IFI
